name: Is AEO more important for some cosmetic procedures than others?

mainEntity.name: Is AEO more important for some cosmetic procedures than others?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is generally important across all cosmetic procedures, but its impact can be more pronounced for frequently researched topics or those with a high volume of informational queries. For example, procedures like "Botox," "lip fillers," "breast augmentation," or "rhinoplasty" often generate many questions about cost, recovery, candidacy, and alternatives. Optimizing for these high-volume, information-seeking queries can yield significant visibility. Less common or highly specialized procedures might benefit more from AEO by establishing authority in a niche, even if query volume is lower.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO is important for all procedures, but can be more impactful for frequently researched treatments like Botox or breast augmentation due to high informational query volume.
